25:68.text: And those who do not invoke
with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden
, except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

25:69.text: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

25:70.text: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

25:71.text: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with

25:72.text: those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

25:73.text: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

25:74.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes

25:75.text: Those will be awarded the Chamber
for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and

25:76.text: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

25:77.text: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?"
